name: parameter-provenance
title: Parameter provenance & digitized Fig 3B/5/7 targets

purpose.question:
What is the authoritative, cited parameter set for reproducing Sego et al.
2022's cellularized influenza model, and where does that authority (the
CC3D ViralInfectionVTM source) disagree with the paper's own printed
tables?
purpose.mechanism:
Documentation only — no simulation is run by this study. It establishes
the parameter/spec authority that all later increments build on.
purpose.expected_outcome:
A cited, machine-readable parameter file (params.yaml) and provenance
docs that a reviewer can audit line-by-line, plus digitized figure-target
acceptance bands, with every source-vs-paper disagreement recorded
explicitly rather than silently resolved.

report.title: Parameter authority established: CC3D source + paper tables, 8 discrepancies recorded
report.objective: Acquire the Sego et al. 2022 supplementary CC3D source (ViralInfectionVTM), transcribe Tables 1-4 into a single cited params.yaml, extend docs/cc3d-reference/ with formula/constant/source documentation, and digitize the target curves from Figs 3B, 5, 7 into acceptance-band data — before any engine code exists.
report.conclusion: The parameter authority for this investigation is established and cited: pbg_cpm_studies/influenza/params.yaml mirrors docs/cc3d-reference/sego2022-parameters.md, every section cites either the paper's Tables 1-4 or the CC3D source directly, and figure-target acceptance bands exist for Figs 3B, 5, 7. Eight places where the CC3D source and the paper's printed tables disagree are recorded, not resolved, in sego2022-parameters.md §7. This is NOT a claim that reproduction has been demonstrated — no simulation exists yet.
report.main_insight: Treating the paper's own supplementary source as ground truth (rather than only its printed tables) surfaces real, previously-implicit modeling choices the paper's prose alone would hide — e.g. the source's NeighborOrder=3 vs. the paper-silent default assumption of 2, and two immune-adhesion entries where the source's per-subtype matrix does not collapse to the paper's stated single value.
report.caveat: This study documents provenance; it does not validate reproduction. The 8 discrepancies in sego2022-parameters.md §7 are open items — params.yaml currently follows the source-literal value in each case (a recorded modeling choice, not a settled resolution). Figure targets are digitized by eye from log-scale panels and are approximate.

study_card.goal: Establish and cite the authoritative parameter set (CC3D source + paper tables) and digitized figure targets before any reproduction engine code is written.
study_card.mechanism: Pure documentation — transcribe params.yaml from the CC3D ViralInfectionVTM source and the paper's Tables 1-4, cross-cited in docs/cc3d-reference/, plus digitized Fig 3B/5/7 acceptance bands.
study_card.why_before_next: Increment 1 (epithelial-sheet-baseline) and every later increment consume params.yaml and the figure targets directly; they must rest on an audited, cited authority rather than ad hoc numbers.

study_card.main_expert_question: Should any of the 8 recorded discrepancies be resolved toward the paper's stated values instead of the source-literal ones before Increment 1 locks params.yaml in as ground truth?

rather than simulates: it cites the parameter authority

evidence.observed: params.yaml (pbg_cpm_studies/influenza/params.yaml) cites every section to either "Sego 2022 Table N" or the CC3D source directly; docs/cc3d-reference/sego2022-parameters.md mirrors it with formulas and constants; three figure-target JSON files (pbg_cpm_studies/influenza/targets/{fig3b,fig5,fig7}.json) digitize acceptance bands from Figs 3B, 5, 7.

findings.statement:
The parameter/spec authority for reproducing Sego et al. 2022 is
established and fully cited (CC3D ViralInfectionVTM source + paper
Tables 1-4), with digitized acceptance-band targets for the three
figures the capstone increment must reproduce. No simulation evidence
exists yet — this finding is about documentation completeness only.

evidence.observed: docs/cc3d-reference/sego2022-parameters.md §7 lists 8 places where the CC3D source and the paper's printed tables disagree: (1) neighbor order 3 (source) vs. an assumed 2 (paper silent), (2) Infected- Macrophage adhesion 20 (source, per-subtype) vs. the paper's collapsed "infected-immune = 10", (3) NKcell-CD8Tcell adhesion 25 (source) vs. the paper's collapsed heterotypic-immune = 10, (4) active lattice dimensions (175x175, source default) matching neither paper patch size exactly, (5) the initial-viral-load sweep {1,10,100,1000,10000} is scenario config, not enumerated in the source's base ModelInputs, (6) ViralCellDeathSteppable is an explicitly "simplified version" omitting the paper's printed ROS/viral-load Hill-saturation death term, (7) ContactKillingSteppable multiplies by cell_resist directly rather than (1 - cell_resist) like every other resistance consumer, (8) macrophage-virus chemotaxis is labeled "moderate" in the paper's table but numerically equals the "strong" NK value (5,000) in both source and paper — a qualitative-label mismatch, not a numeric one.

findings.statement:
Eight source-vs-paper discrepancies are recorded as open items rather
than silently resolved. params.yaml currently follows the CC3D
source-literal value in each numeric case, per the controller ruling
that the source is what actually produced the published figures — but
this is a recorded modeling choice, not a settled resolution, and is
carried forward as a decision_needed at the investigation level.

key_assumptions: The CC3D ViralInfectionVTM supplementary source is treated as the authoritative, source-literal parameter reference where it disagrees with the paper's printed tables (controller ruling; see decisions_needed at the investigation level).
Figure targets (Figs 3B, 5, 7) are digitized by eye from log-scale panels in the published PDF and are approximate acceptance bands, not extracted vector/tabular data.
params.yaml's chemotaxis functional_form is noted as saturating/COM in the source while the engine currently implements a linear term — recorded as a future-increment gap, not resolved here.

conclusion:
Increment 0's documentation goal is met: the parameter authority is
established, cited, and cross-checked against the CC3D source, with 8
disagreements recorded rather than hidden, and digitized acceptance-band
targets exist for the three figures the capstone increment must
eventually reproduce. This study makes no claim about reproduction
fidelity — that is out of scope until Increment 1 introduces the first
simulation code.

biological_summary:
This study does not simulate biology — it documents the parameter
authority a future simulation will use. Sego et al. 2022's cellularized
influenza model specifies epithelial, macrophage, NK, and CD8+ T cell
types; diffusible virus, type-I IFN, chemokine, and IL-10 fields; per-cell
resistance and death/recovery rules; and chemotactic recruitment
strengths — all summarized with formulas and cited constants in
docs/cc3d-reference/sego2022-parameters.md and encoded machine-readably in
pbg_cpm_studies/influenza/params.yaml. Establishing this authority first,
and recording where the paper's own supplementary source disagrees with
its printed tables, lets every later increment build on an audited
foundation instead of quietly picking whichever number seemed
plausible.
